Hi Lucie,

Following our call yesterday, attaching an initial private offer for MedTech that aligns the EU renewal and the planned APAC rollout. High-level summary:

- Term: 18 months (aligns with your procurement window)
- Capacity: base committed capacity for EU year 1, staged APAC uplift at months 6 and 12
- Billing: quarterly invoices, with an option to stagger APAC tranches into separate invoice tranches if tax/PO timing requires

Attached: medtech_private_offer_terms_v2.pdf (redline of commercial terms).

1) You confirm the staged uplift schedule (dates for M6/M12)
2) We route the final PO + DocuSign envelope for signature

If helpful, Kimberly and Priyom are looped for regional billing questions and the acceptance path.

Thanks,

Hi Hannah — thanks, this looks promising. A few clarifying questions from procurement/security: 

1) We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short summary of data residency commitments for the EU portion (we're legally required to keep certain telemetry in-region). Can you confirm?
2) For APAC staged uplift — will the tranches be treated as separate POs or amendments? Our APAC entity prefers separate POs for tax reasons.
3) Pricing question: is there a mid-term CPI or usage true-up at the M12 uplift?

If you can answer the above, we can prepare procurement timelines and get legal involved.

Best,

Hi Lucie — looping in the answers inline below.

1) SOC2 & Data residency: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II attestation and a one-page evidence summary; for EU regional residency we will pin the EU workloads to our EU-dedicated region under the Private deployment option and include a contractual data residency clause. Attaching the evidence summary now.

2) APAC tranches: we can support either approach. If your APAC entity requires separate POs for tax/legal, we'll split the APAC uplift into two separate PO-able tranches (M6 and M12) while keeping the commercial term consolidated under a single private-offer agreement. That preserves the term / pricing while giving you separate invoice/PO objects.

3) Mid-term true-up: pricing as proposed includes a one-time uplift at the M12 tranche; there is no CPI indexing during the 18 months. If you prefer a usage true-up model we can propose a minimal true-up clause instead — happy to outline both options in a final SOW.

Attaching: soc2-type2-evidence-summary.pdf (PDF, 128KB).

I'll draft the PO split language and share an updated PDF for DocuSign if you confirm separate APAC POs.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
